name: lean-proofs (Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib)
onCreateCommand: curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh -o /tmp/elan-init.sh && bash /tmp/elan-init.sh -y --default-toolchain none && $HOME/.elan/bin/lake exe cache get
postAttachCommand: echo 'Run ./check.sh to verify everything (about the time in AUDIT.log, more on a cold machine).'
